evidence: The report is about crashreporter client build ID derivation, which belongs to the crash reporting component.
The bug specifically mentions split views being incorrectly marked hidden in collapsed groups after session restore.
Bug concerns EventStateManager updating cached pointer coordinates during pointer lock, i.e. DOM user-input event handling.
Bug is in the DevTools Computed panel's OutputParser for CSS shape-outside, owned by the Inspector rules team.
The crash and fix are in IndexedDB's ActorsParent.cpp, specifically PBackgroundIDBRequest/NormalTransactionOp IPC handling.
Bug concerns Glean `search.engine.default.*` probes for the default search engine not being updated by the search service when the engine name changes.
The report targets `.urlbar-input-box` RTL margin in the Firefox address bar, which matches Firefox::Address Bar under [Search Next Generation].
The report only asks to revert the fix for bug 2033848 and names no component, technology, or symptom that identifies the owning team.
The report is about focus handling for the 'View site information' trust/identity panel opened from the lock icon area.
The failing test is in browser/components/customizableui and involves customizing from the overflow panel, matching Firefox::Toolbars and Customization.
The bug is in browser/components/urlbar/UrlbarParentController and browser/actors/UrlbarParent.sys.mjs, which belong to the address bar team.

The fix targets nsWindowWatcher::CalculateChromeFlagsForContent, which decides chrome flags when creating a top-level window via window.open, matching 'Core::Window Management' (creation and management of top-level windows).
The bug is in nsPipe, implemented in mozilla/xpcom/io, which is covered by Core::XPCOM.
The report is explicitly about the about:neterror / net-error-card illustration asset (security-error.svg) used on cert and net error pages, which is Toolkit::Error Pages' scope.
The alert tracks DAMP (DevTools) performance tests like browser-toolbox.inspector-ready and styleeditor-ready, pointing to the DevTools component team.
The report is about the Server Not Found about:neterror page, its copy, and its Learn More link.
The report targets the about:settings#privacy Security warnings card and its reset button in Firefox Settings UI.
Report concerns ParamTraits deserialization in widget/nsGUIEventIPC.h, i.e. the IPDL IPC serialization system for WidgetEvent events.
The unwanted favicon.ico fetch is triggered specifically after opening a PDF, pointing at the built-in PDF viewer (pdf.js) page that produces the request.
The crash is in dom/canvas/DrawTargetWebgl.cpp, the accelerated backend for the HTML canvas 2D element.
The bug title and comments explicitly reference SearchWidgetTracker and the search-container search bar widget, pointing to Firefox::Search.
The report is about WebAssembly memory64 bounds checking and spectre-mitigations, matching the WebAssembly implementation component.
The bug is in SERPCategorization.sys.mjs, part of Firefox's search telemetry/SERP categorization code, owned by Firefox::Search.
The report concerns an incorrect default light theme color token for a Firefox UI element, pointing to Firefox::Theme.
The bug is about the tracking/protection panel's toggle HCM styling, which is explicitly covered by Firefox::Protections UI.
The failure involves the mozglue/baseprofiler ProfilingCategoryList.h (profiling/tracing infrastructure), but no build-system team is listed, making routing ambiguous.
The failures are WPT tests under /svg/animations for animateMotion path handling, which falls under SVG layout/rendering and interacting with the SVG DOM.
The crash is in js/src/wasm/WasmPI.cpp and WasmModule.cpp involving WebAssembly.promising/JSPI, which is owned by the JavaScript team's WebAssembly component.
The bug is in servo/components/style/rule_cache.rs and @starting-style cascade logic, which maps to Core::CSS Parsing and Computation under the [Layout] team.
The bug is in accessible/xul/XULFormControlAccessible.cpp, a Core accessibility implementation.
The bug references the Spotlight template and its additional_cta/background properties, which are part of the Firefox Messaging System.
The report explicitly mentions enabling Metal ANGLE for WebGL and slow compilation of ANGLE's internal shaders, pointing to the ANGLE graphics component.
The build error references masm.callWithABI<Fn, jit::InitBaselineFrameForOsr>, a JavaScript JIT compiler issue on riscv64/mips64.
The report concerns the media-triage-bot's comment formatting for Bugzilla bug links, and mentions Media+AI=padenot.
The overflow occurs inside ANGLE's renderer_utils.cpp/copyimage.cpp fast-copy path, which the ANGLE component explicitly owns as the third-party library capture bucket.
The test webrtc/mdns-candidate-obfuscation.html exercises WebRTC mDNS ICE candidate obfuscation, which falls under Core::WebRTC: Networking in the Media team.
The bug is in widget/gtk keymap handling, owned by Core::Widget: Gtk under the OS Integration team.
The crash is a null deref in nsTextFrame::GetSelectionDetails (layout/generic/nsTextFrame.cpp), a text-frame selection bug reached via the display-list/WebRender paint path.
Crash stack shows RestyleManager::DoReparentComputedStyleForFirstLine and nsIFrame::CorrectStyleParentFrame, and Core::Layout: Block and Inline explicitly covers ::first-line issues.
Bug reports a fetch from a dedicated worker not being intercepted by the controlling service worker, which belongs in Core::DOM: Service Workers (DOM LWS team).
The assertion is in FOG/Telemetry initialization via StartupTelemetry.initFOG(), matching Toolkit::Telemetry.
The bug is in widget/cocoa/MOZDynamicCursor.mm, which is Cocoa widget code.
The bug is about Firefox VPN panel behavior after CFR dismissal and toolbar re-add, which points to the Firefox VPN component.
The report only cites unspecified Figma design inconsistencies without any named feature or component, making it too ambiguous to route.
The crash is an index-out-of-bounds panic in gfx/wr/webrender/src/prepare.rs, directly in the WebRender code.
Report accompanies a .har network capture and describes a site that hangs after an update while other browsers connect, pointing to the networking stack.
Failure is in the css-typed-om StylePropertyMap test (CSSOM/Typed OM) asserting the computed animation-duration value.
The warning references widget/gtk/ScreenHelperGTK.cpp, a GTK platform widget source file.
The bug is in dom/file/MutableBlobStorage.cpp, which implements DOM Blob storage, so Core::DOM: File owns the fix.
Bug is about HTML parser's adoption agency algorithm / DOM tree construction (Core::DOM: HTML Parser), which belongs to the DOM Core team.

The bug is in the Reporting API's report delivery (dom/reporting/ReportDeliver.cpp, DeprecationReportBody.cpp) leaking URL fragments, which is filed under Core::DOM: Security, owned by the Security Engineering team.
The report is about a print job produced with wrong colors despite Black and White selection, which points at printing output rather than preview rendering.
Backtrace shows assertion in js::wasm::TypeContext::indexOf during WebAssembly Ion compilation.
The RST_STREAM handling and NS_ERROR_NET_RESET mapping occur in Http2Session.cpp, i.e. Mozilla's HTTP networking code.
Crash frames are in modules/libjar/nsJARChannel.cpp and nsJARProtocolHandler, i.e. the jar protocol handler owned by Core::Networking: JAR.
The report only describes a browser chrome test failing when the 'nova' front-end feature pref is enabled, pointing at generic Firefox front-end UI code.
The report names an infinite loop in querySelector, a DOM API implemented in DOM: Core & HTML with selector matching in CSS Parsing and Computation.
The bug mentions hiding the 'Clear Data' option from the shield icon panel in private browsing, which points to the Protections UI.
Bug is in RTCDTMFSender.insertDTMF, part of the WebRTC DTMF/peerconnection code (dom/media/webrtc/jsapi/), which falls under the Core::WebRTC components.
The crash stack includes dom/media/webspeech/recognition/SpeechRecognitionParent.cpp, pointing to the Web Speech API speech recognition implementation.
The test name test_wasm_offthread_compile.html and 'source phase wasm module' point to WebAssembly off-thread compilation.
The bug concerns Firefox tab groups and split view, both owned by Frontend tabbed browser components.
